question: Lakshmi Shankar was a Hindustani classical vocalist of the _________ Gharana.
solution:
The correct answer is** Patiala.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lakshmi Shankar **was an Indian singer and a noted Hindustani classical.
 
• Born into a south **Indian Brahmin family.**
 
• She became an outstanding Hindustani vocalist of the **Patiala Gharana** and married Rajendra Shankar, brother of Uday Shankar, a Bengali by birth.
 
• **A special feature of the Patiala Gharana **approach to singing is its rendering of intricate taans.​ 
 
• Hindustani classical music is the classical music of the northern regions of the Indian subcontinent.
 
• It may also be called North Indian classical music or, in Hindustani.
 
• ​The Hindustani music style is mainly found in North India, Pakistan, and Bangladesh. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Gwalior Gharana** evolved during the time of the Mughal Empire.
 
• **The name Agra Rangeela Gharana**, representing his soft and vibrant gayaki.
 
• **The name of this school of music derives from Kirana,** a town and tehsil of Shamli District in Uttar Pradesh.
